name: Клинок Шёлковых шапочек
notes: A duelist of the Шёлковые шапочки, Мирайя's people, a generic type fought in pairs. Blades walk beside her in the street and stand between her and anyone who comes too close. A blade feints and steps before it cuts, and makes anyone who swings at it and misses pay for it. They are hired swords of a desert syndicate a long way from home, loyal to her pay and to her temper. Human ancestry is assigned for play, not canon. Table notes: Silk Parry and Duelist's Measure are toggles; Silk Parry lasts until the start of the blade's next turn.

standardItems.text: The blade deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] creatures.

actions.name: Darting Feint
actions.text: The blade [[/act feint]]{Feints}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Step]{Steps}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Strike]{Strikes} in any order.

actions.name: Silk Parry
actions.text: The blade holds its main-gauche across its guard and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of its next turn. While the bonus lasts, the blade can use Riposte when an enemy fails a Strike against it, not only on a critical failure.

actions.name: Riposte
actions.text:
Trigger A creature within the blade's reach critically fails a Strike against it, or fails one while Silk Parry is active

Effect The blade makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature or attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Disarm] it with its main-gauche.

actions.name: Duelist's Measure
actions.text: When the blade and an enemy are adjacent to each other and no other creature is adjacent to either of them, the blade gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against that enemy.
